verdict.rationale: Gumloop's public API documents creating and updating agents, which are its automation unit, including a Create Agent endpoint and SDK resource clients for agents. Nothing shows that an agent can activate an automation through the API, such as enabling a schedule, app trigger or webhook trigger; triggers are documented only as product features. missing for 10: API endpoint to activate/enable triggers or schedules on an agent, an update-agent endpoint reference page, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven creation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API
